Parse each item's markup and compare the plain text:

```python
from rich.text import Text
plain = Text.from_markup(item_text).plain
```

`Text.from_markup` parses Rich markup into `Text`, and `.plain` gives you the text without style tags. See the [markup API docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). For further usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
